# Marie C Domingo CPA

Marie C Domingo CPA is an accounting firm in Eagle Rock, Los Angeles, California.
Marie Domingo has practiced public accounting since 1985 and established the firm in 1997.
The firm serves individuals, businesses, estates, and trusts.
Services are tax preparation and planning, IRS representation, bookkeeping and accounting, payroll services, estate and trust planning, and business consulting.
The firm works in strategic alliance with the Law Offices of Ruperto D. Domingo for estate planning, probate, and trust work.
The office is at 815 Colorado Blvd, Suite 320, Los Angeles, CA 90041.
Office hours are Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5:30 PM.
Call (323) 256-7770 or write to mariecpa@domingolawcpa.com.
First consultations are free.
Website: https://www.domingolawcpa.com/
